image_description: A wall-mounted aneroid barometer with a circular wooden casing and a long, paddle-shaped wooden handle extending downwards. The dial face is visible behind glass, featuring a brass-colored bezel and markings. There is a small rectangular thermometer embedded in the lower part of the wooden handle. The background is a white slatted wall.

The small rectangular thermometer embedded in the handle lacks distinct internal structure (scale/mercury); it appears as a vague greyish rectangle with a yellow blob at the bottom, lacking logical mechanical detail.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'thermometer' inset on the handle. In AI images, secondary functional elements often fail to render with logical internal structure. Also, distinguish between 'bad photo quality' (blur) and 'generative blur' (smearing of distinct edges).
